title: Minecraft: Java Edition
notes: Vault reads the advancements file each world saves (saves\<world>\advancements) and never touches the game. Every vanilla advancement becomes a Vault achievement, across all your worlds.
Works with the official Minecraft Launcher and with Prism, MultiMC, ATLauncher, CurseForge and Modrinth instances.
Only singleplayer worlds are on your PC. Advancements earned on a multiplayer server are kept by the server.
Minecraft for Windows (Bedrock) has its own Xbox achievements, so this set is for Java Edition only.

testGuide.title: Open a world
testGuide.detail: Start Vault, then open any singleplayer world and pick up a log or craft a crafting table. Within a few seconds of the game saving (pause with Esc to force a save), "Minecraft" and "Stone Age" style achievements should pop up.

testGuide.title: Old worlds
testGuide.detail: Worlds you played before installing Vault count too: their advancements are picked up the first time Vault sees them.
